title: Talent Acquisition Specialist
description:
Job Description We are looking for a proactive and tech-savvy Talent Acquisition Specialist to support end-to-end IT hiring. The role involves managing multiple recruitment pipelines across India and US time zones, collaborating with technical teams, and delivering a strong candidate experience. 
 Skill / Qualifications Bachelors/Master’s degree or Diploma in IT, HR, or related field 2+ years of experience in IT/technical recruitment Good understanding of IT technologies such as Java, .NET, Python, Cloud, DevOps, SAP, etc. Strong sourcing skills and knowledge of Boolean search Proficient in MS Excel, Word, Outlook, and PowerPoint Strong communication and stakeholder management skills Ability to handle multiple roles and work in rotational (US) shifts Preferred Qualifications Experience hiring for US or international clients Exposure to ATS tools and recruitment platforms Team handling or mentoring experience is an advantage 
 Job Responsibilities Source and engage IT talent through LinkedIn, Naukri, referrals, and other channels Manage full-cycle recruitment: screening, interviews, coordination, and offer closure Partner with hiring managers to understand requirements and hiring priorities Maintain ATS data, reports, trackers, and MIS Build and manage talent pipelines for niche and critical roles Post and manage job openings across platforms Coordinate interviews and hiring activities across India and US time zones

Key Skills: Talent acquisition,IT recruitment,End To End Recruitment,Recruitment,End,Acquisition,End To End,US recruitment
